routing.governance: Material tax, compliance and portfolio actions require deterministic validation and human approval after the model route.

roles.role: Produces bounded portfolio, tax and compliance analysis drafts inside SARVAX agents. Deterministic calculators and advisor approval own the final decision.
roles.why: Its retained TAU Banking result is 0.3340, the highest value in this report’s retained 40-configuration comparison set. This is a shortlist signal, not proof of production accuracy.
roles.tradeoff: Use only where a wealth-advisory journey needs deeper financial reasoning. Meeting notes, routing and routine extraction should not pay this cost or inherit this latency.

roles.role: Normalizes high-volume text from meeting transcripts, email, WhatsApp exports, CRM notes, research and text-native statements before SARVAX agents reason over it.
roles.why: The official rate card verifies the exact SKU, low cache-hit pricing, JSON output, tool calls and a 1M context window—useful for large client-context assembly.
roles.tradeoff: It is a text-context worker, not the product. Image-origin evidence still needs the Vision Gate; extracted facts must retain source references and pass journey-specific validation.
roles.status: Official SKU and price verified; task quality unproven

roles.role: Identifies the wealth-advisory journey, urgency, household context and required SARVAX agent/workflow before expensive processing begins.
roles.why: Google describes it as its fastest, most cost-effective 3.5 model for high-throughput execution. The retained snapshot reports 362.2 tps; its verified input rate is ₹28.97/1M.
roles.tradeoff: Use for routing, classification and low-risk extraction checks—not investment, tax or compliance conclusions. Low-confidence routing must fall back to review.

roles.role: Handles image-origin evidence—scanned KYC records, photographed forms, charts and statement pages—when a broader wealth-advisory journey actually needs it.
roles.why: Google’s model page describes Gemini 3.6 Flash as supporting agentic and multimodal tasks. The retained snapshot reports 243.9 tps.
roles.tradeoff: Multimodal identity does not prove financial-document OCR accuracy. Validate tables, decimal placement, signatures and low-quality scans; escalate low-confidence evidence.

qa_corrections: Replaced PDF/file-type routes with three wealth-advisory product journeys.
Mapped all 12 SARVAX wealth-advisory agents to relationship, portfolio/market and compliance/operations journeys.
Mapped product surfaces only where frontend code or API contracts exist; specific wealth connector availability is not implied.
Kept deterministic math, policy, authorization and human approval outside the model chain.
Retained model evidence boundaries: benchmark performance is a shortlist signal, not production authorization.
routing.scope: SARVAX wealth-advisory product mapping; models are components, not the product.

journeys.label: Client Relationship Intelligence
journeys.summary: Turns meetings and ongoing client communication into advisor-ready context, follow-ups and controlled system updates.
journeys.outcome: Every advisor starts prepared, leaves with structured actions and keeps the client record current.
journeys.guardrail: Meeting intelligence drafts context and actions. The advisor approves material client communication and every financial recommendation.

journeys.label: Portfolio & Market Intelligence
journeys.summary: Combines holdings, market context and client objectives into review-ready portfolio and tax-analysis drafts.
journeys.outcome: Faster portfolio reviews with traceable evidence, deterministic calculations and advisor-controlled recommendations.
journeys.guardrail: Models can draft analysis. Deterministic portfolio/tax engines validate the math; the advisor owns suitability and final action.

journeys.label: Compliance & Advisor Operations
journeys.summary: Routes KYC, review cadence, pipeline, workload and document events through bounded agents and approval-controlled workflows.
journeys.outcome: Fewer missed obligations, cleaner KYC evidence and visible ownership across the advisory team.
journeys.guardrail: Policy rules and deterministic validation remain outside the model chain. Compliance exceptions and material account changes require named human approval.

relationship.name: Client Relationship Intelligence
relationship.classification: Accurate Token & Costing Model — Verified Model Rates (ECB ₹96.57/$1)
relationship.description: From permitted client context to advisor-approved follow-up and controlled system writeback.
relationship.decision: Can SARVAX preserve evidence, ownership and human decision rights across the complete meeting journey?
relationship.verdict: Product orchestration and exact step-level token costing represented with assigned frontier models and human gates.
relationship.release_gap: Connector execution, persistence, retry behavior and production reliability require representative backend traces.
relationship.exit_gate: Release only after consent, tenant isolation, source lineage, approval and writeback controls pass representative trace tests.

steps.name: Permitted client-context intake
steps.desc: Calendar, CRM and approved communication context are collected before preparation.
steps.control: Required: consent, tenant access, source timestamps and retention policy.

steps.name: Pre-Meeting Analysis Agent
steps.desc: Drafts a source-linked preparation brief and explicit data gaps.
steps.control: Required: unsupported client facts blocked; every material claim links to retained evidence.

steps.name: Meeting capture and artifact finalization
steps.desc: Meeting Assistant creates the permitted transcript and meeting artifacts.
steps.control: Required: participant consent, speaker attribution review and artifact access policy.

steps.name: Post-Meeting Analysis Agent
steps.desc: Drafts facts, decisions, risks and action items from the retained artifact.
steps.control: Required: transcript facts remain separate from model interpretation.

steps.name: Client Intelligence Strategist
steps.desc: Drafts next-best-action options for advisor review using TAU SOTA reasoning.
steps.control: Required: no autonomous product recommendation, promise or client communication.

steps.name: Advisor decision gate
steps.desc: The named advisor accepts, edits or rejects facts and proposed actions.
steps.control: Required before any client communication or material CRM/task update.

steps.name: Controlled Workflow 2.0 writeback
steps.desc: Only approved records are submitted to authorized connected systems.
steps.control: Release evidence required: idempotency key, immutable audit event, retry/dead-letter policy and compensating action.

portfolio.name: Portfolio & Market Intelligence

portfolio.description: From holdings evidence to deterministic calculations, advisor review and approved system updates.
portfolio.decision: Can model-generated observations remain subordinate to exact financial calculations and advisor suitability decisions?
portfolio.verdict: The control placement and exact step-level costing are represented across DeepSeek and Kimi K3 models.
portfolio.release_gap: Connector coverage, calculation parity and order-system writeback require representative traces.
portfolio.exit_gate: Release only after as-of controls, Decimal-oracle parity, suitability approval and writeback authorization pass representative cases.

steps.name: Holdings and market-evidence intake
steps.desc: Approved connectors, OneChat artifacts or uploaded evidence enter with source metadata.
steps.control: Required: connector identity, as-of timestamp, currency and data lineage.

steps.name: Deterministic intake gate
steps.desc: Schema, completeness, duplicates, stale values and authorization are checked.
steps.control: Blocked inputs cannot proceed; every exception receives an owner and reason.

steps.name: Bounded context normalization
steps.desc: Extraction links narrative context to retained evidence without changing numeric holdings.
steps.control: Image-origin evidence uses a separately validated OCR/vision route only when required.

steps.name: Market Intelligence Agent
steps.desc: Drafts time-stamped event and market-context observations.
steps.control: Required: public/source references and explicit freshness on every material claim.

steps.name: Portfolio Analyst
steps.desc: Drafts allocation, concentration and risk observations using TAU Banking reasoning.
steps.control: Narrative generation cannot alter holdings, prices, tax lots or computed values.

steps.name: Deterministic finance and policy gate
steps.desc: Versioned Decimal services calculate returns, allocation, tax lots and policy checks.
steps.control: Required: formula version, input hash, regression fixture and materiality threshold.

steps.name: Advisor suitability gate
steps.desc: The named advisor accepts, edits or rejects the analysis and proposed action.
steps.control: Mandatory before client delivery, order staging or material record update.

steps.name: Authorized writeback
steps.desc: Approved artifacts and tasks are submitted to authorized connected systems.
steps.control: Release evidence required: authorization, idempotency, immutable audit log and compensating action.

owners.deterministic: Identity, sanctions, schema and authorization gates

steps.name: Case and evidence intake
steps.desc: Connected systems, tasks, messages and client evidence enter with source metadata.
steps.control: Required: case identity, consent, source integrity and tenant boundary.

steps.name: Deterministic identity and access gate
steps.desc: Identity, tenant, consent, schema and authorization are verified before model processing.
steps.control: Missing or conflicting controls block the case and create a review reason.

steps.name: KYC and document intelligence
steps.desc: KYC Officer, KYC/CDD QA and Document Intelligence prepare review evidence using multimodal vision.
steps.control: Required: field-level extraction confidence, source link and unresolved-field list.

steps.name: Deterministic evidence and policy gate
steps.desc: Schema, sanctions-source results, policy rules and exceptions are evaluated.
steps.control: Models cannot override failed checks, missing evidence or reviewer-required cases.

steps.name: Bounded operations agent group
steps.desc: Cadence, campaign, pipeline and workload agents prepare owned follow-up work.
steps.control: Every proposed action requires owner, due date, metric and dependency.

steps.name: Named human review gate
steps.desc: The authorized reviewer accepts, rejects or returns the case with a reason.
steps.control: Mandatory for material decisions, outbound actions and unresolved evidence.

steps.name: Controlled notifications and writeback
steps.desc: Only approved state is submitted to tasks and authorized connected systems.
steps.control: Release evidence required: audit ID, retry/dead-letter policy, deduplication and compensating action.

aviva_qaqc.description: Monitors shared email inbox (50 lab reports/day), parses Micro vs. Analytical PDF reports, updates central Excel tracker, executes 6-month repeat lot skip-test logic, and sends 8 AM daily executive summary.

steps.name: Shared Email Inbox Monitoring
steps.desc: Monitors lab inbox, identifies Micro vs Analytical report attachments, and routes to storage.

steps.name: Micro & Analytical PDF Parser
steps.desc: Extracts lab test metrics (Heavy Metals, Micro, Potency) using 258 tok/page multimodal vision.
steps.control: Required: per-field extraction confidence score; values below 0.95 flagged for human review.

steps.name: Excel Lab Tracker Auto-Update
steps.desc: Applies status rules (Pass / Yellow OOS / Red Fail) and updates central Excel tracker rows.
steps.control: Required: atomic sheet locks, row-level idempotency key, and color-coded status styling.

steps.name: 6-Month Repeat Lot Skip-Test Check
steps.desc: Cross-checks vendor 6-month lot history to evaluate if repeat tests can be waived.
steps.control: Required: historical lot database query and explicit waiver authorization check.

steps.name: 8 AM Daily Executive Summary Email Gate
steps.desc: Aviva QA team approves 24-hour summary email before morning dispatch to plant managers.
steps.control: Mandatory sign-off before sending outbound email summary or executing vendor rejection.
